children: Doha: Qatar Airways has announced a special offer on Economy, Business and First Class tickets.
The offer, valid until September 17, 2026, is available for Qatar Airways return flight itineraries originating from Doha.
The national carrier added that flights to Beirut operated by Middle East Airlines and flights to Amman operated by Royal Jordanian are excluded from the offer.
This discount is available for travel period until December 9, 2026. The airlines stated that blackout dates for flights departing from Doha are October 22-24, 2026.
Similar blackout dates apply to return flights to Doha from the network on October 29 to 31, 2026; January 2 to 9, 2027; March 12 -14, 2027; and May 21 - 22, 2027.
The airline warned that seats are limited and subject to availability. The offer cannot be combined with publicly available promotional fares.

title: ZAWYA: Qatar Airways announces limited-time flight discounts for Doha travellers
